dataset.description: Run-to-failure telemetry for 100 simulated turbofan engines (21 sensors, 3 operating settings). The training file has no target column: Sentinel derives it from the run-to-failure structure. The official test file is held out and labelled by NASA's RUL file.

meta.source: NASA Prognostics Center of Excellence, C-MAPSS

dataset.name: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 turbofan degradation

decisions.outcome: op3, s1, s5, s10, s16, s18, s19: constant column (zero information)
'unit' has 100 contiguous blocks and 'cycle' rises by exactly 1 within each block (median block length 199)
each unit's series ends at failure -> target derived as remaining useful life (RUL)
alarm horizon = round(0.15 x median life) = 30 cycle steps; target = fails within 30
the dataset ships an official holdout; it is never used for model selection
balanced enough -> rank by cross-validated ROC-AUC
minority class below 30% -> balanced class weights on every candidate
fixed search space: LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Linear baseline
17 sensors x (current, 5-step mean, 5-step std, 10-step slope, 5-step change) + cycle = 86 features
cross-validation folds are grouped by unit: no unit is ever in train and validation together
XGBoost ranks first on cross-validated roc_auc (higher is better): the numbers picked it, and the holdout was not consulted
alert threshold = the out-of-fold score that maximises F1
global importance from 3000 training rows; top driver: Ps30 static pressure at HPC outlet, 5-cycle average (12%)
native Tree-SHAP equals shap.TreeExplainer to within 0.0e+00 on 400 rows
champion logged to MLflow and registered as sentinel-cmapss_fd001 (alias: champion)
versioned FastAPI service generated with the same features.py and Tree-SHAP code used in training
service reproduces the trained model's scores
drift monitor armed on 85 feature distributions (early-life window, 50 cycles); retrain rule: any top-10 feature PSI >= 0.25
